name: unslop
description: Generate and validate domain-specific anti-slop profiles from bundled Python scripts without runtime source fetching or Anthropic CLI dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Generate and validate domain-specific anti-slop profiles from local samples.
interface.longDescription: Asset Marketplace-owned unslop package for GPT and Codex workflows. It bundles Python scripts for text-mode analysis, optional visual evidence smoke checks, output manifests, and profile validation without runtime source fetching or Anthropic CLI dependencies.
defaultPrompt: Use $unslop to generate a domain-specific profile from local samples, validate the output, and report any optional visual evidence that was skipped.
